data.description:
Show products below their reorder threshold on the home screen using the `AlertCard` component.

* Data from apollo-api `GET /alerts/stock`
* Group by store, sort by how far below threshold
* Nightly refresh is enough (Sarah Kim confirmed real-time isn't needed)
